title: Hopfield neural networks as port-Hamiltonian and gradient systems
summary: The structure of continuous Hopfield networks is revisited from a system-theoretic point of view. After adopting a novel electrical network interpretation involving nonlinear capacitors, it is shown that Hopfield networks admit a port-Hamiltonian formulation provided an extra passivity condition is satisfied. Subsequently it is shown that any Hopfield network can be represented as a gradient system, with Riemannian metric given by the inverse of the Hessian matrix of the total energy stored in the nonlinear capacitors.
